description: Controlled semantic reviewer evaluation. Synthetic cases are not factual news or publications. evaluate_review.py expand() rebuilds each full case.

sources.title: dirauth: Remove bastet from list
passages: Last night, bastet's operator notified us that the machine is very plausibly compromised.
In any kind of scenario here, the keys can't be trusted anymore and bastet will generate a new identity soon.
In the meantime, remove bastet from source as we can't trust it anymore.

sources.title: Re: Relay incident report
passages: New reply: Thanks for the report; I have no new measurements or findings.
Quoted earlier message: Two relays experienced overload on Tor 1.2.3 last week. The original cause is unknown.

sources.title: Measured relay resource exhaustion
passages: The author reports a new controlled study on 40 relays using Tor 1.2.3 during November 8–9. Its measurements show a directory-request rate limit refusing about half the requests while admitted directory streams still saturated the measured main threads.
The study does not identify an attacker or establish that all Tor relays are affected.

sources.title: Release preparation checklist
passages: [x] For each approved security patch, merge the patch.
[x] Publish each prepared crate.
[ ] Complete post-release dependency checks.
This is a generic procedure checklist and identifies no particular release version or shipped security fix.

sources.title: Stable release announcement

sources.title: Persistent file cleanup report
passages: The reporter alleges that persistent nonce files permit practical remote disk exhaustion.

A maintainer says the demonstration only calls a local helper and does not send network requests. The maintainer acknowledges a file-cleanup defect but disputes that a practical vulnerability was established.
